title: PolyTypesShiftRow
html:
定义组：System F 双绑定替换与规约。有序参数：z2008、z2009、z2010。

只提升对应种类的自由指标；两种绑定深度分开。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ PolyTypesShiftRow z2008 z2009 z2010) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists c
  (exists k
    (exists t
      (exists u
        (and
          (exists z2013
            (and (exists z2014 (and (@ Pair t u z2014) (@ Pair k z2014 z2013))) (@ Pair c z2013 z2010)))
          (and
            (@ Nat c)
            (and
              (@ Nat k)
              (and
                (@ PolyAny t)
                (and
                  (@ PolyAny u)
                  (or
                    (exists z2015 (and (@ TVar z2015 t) (= t u)))
                    (or
                      (exists z2017
                        (exists z2018
                          (exists z2019
                            (exists z2020
                            (exists z2025
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z2017 z2019 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TLam z2018 z2020 u)
                            (and
                            (@ FTyShift c k z2017 z2018)
                            (and
                            (= z2025 c)
                            (exists z2026
                            (exists z2027
                            (and
                            (in z2026 z2009)
                            (and
                            (@ App z2008 z2026 z2027)
                            (exists z2028
                            (and (exists z2029 (and (@ Pair z2019 z2020 z2029) (@ Pair k z2029 z2028))) (@ Pair z2025 z2028 z2027))))))))))))))))
                      (or
                        (exists z2021
                          (exists z2022
                            (exists z2023
                            (exists z2024
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z2021 z2022 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z2023 z2024 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z2030
                            (exists z2031
                            (and
                            (in z2030 z2009)
                            (and
                            (@ App z2008 z2030 z2031)
                            (exists z2032
                            (and (exists z2033 (and (@ Pair z2021 z2023 z2033) (@ Pair k z2033 z2032))) (@ Pair c z2032 z2031)))))))
                            (exists z2034
                            (exists z2035
                            (and
                            (in z2034 z2009)
                            (and
                            (@ App z2008 z2034 z2035)
                            (exists z2036
                            (and (exists z2037 (and (@ Pair z2022 z2024 z2037) (@ Pair k z2037 z2036))) (@ Pair c z2036 z2035))))))))))))))
                        (or
                          (exists z2019
                            (exists z2020
                            (exists z2025
                            (and
                            (@ FTAbs z2019 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FTAbs z2020 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Succ c z2025)
                            (exists z2038
                            (exists z2039
                            (and
                            (in z2038 z2009)
                            (and
                            (@ App z2008 z2038 z2039)
                            (exists z2040
                            (and (exists z2041 (and (@ Pair z2019 z2020 z2041) (@ Pair k z2041 z2040))) (@ Pair z2025 z2040 z2039)))))))))))))
                          (exists z2021
                            (exists z2023
                            (exists z2017
                            (exists z2018
                            (and
                            (@ FTInst z2021 z2017 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FTInst z2023 z2018 u)
                            (and
                            (exists z2042
                            (exists z2043
                            (and
                            (in z2042 z2009)
                            (and
                            (@ App z2008 z2042 z2043)
                            (exists z2044
                            (and (exists z2045 (and (@ Pair z2021 z2023 z2045) (@ Pair k z2045 z2044))) (@ Pair c z2044 z2043)))))))
                            (@ FTyShift c k z2017 z2018)))))))))))))))))))))
